Required Technical Skills Back-End Ruby (5+ years, expert-level) Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred) PostgreSQL (or MySQL) Elasticsearch Redis Docker Front-End StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6 Tailwind CSS HTML HTTP AI Integration Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic) Nice-to-Have Technical Skills Kubernetes for microservices orchestration React for advanced front-end components Graph databases for complex financial data Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects Required Soft Skills Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code Team player comfortable as an individual contributor Why Join Us? Autonomy and Influence : Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate. Competitive Compensation : $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits. Remote Flexibility : Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC Growth Opportunities : Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation. Dynamic Culture : Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech. MLS defines the cryptographic core of group messaging and leaves delivery, ordering, identity and federation to whoever integrates it. That's the part we build: a Rust SDK, the server that orders and delivers MLS messages, and its integration with Matrix. Much of it has no off-the-shelf answer yet. We're also following the IETF's MIMI effort, which aims to let different messengers interoperate over MLS, and expect it to shape how our system federates. How we work: Small team, close collaboration. At Famedly the MLS team will be four to five engineers. We build the system together with a larger group of engineers at partner companies. Ownership in small groups. Day to day you work with two or three others on a project or a part of the system, and you own it from spec to operations. AI where it helps, people where it counts. We use coding agents a lot, for implementation, tests and exploring options. Protocol design, security-relevant decisions and the final review stay with people, and we keep adjusting where that line runs. Think first, then build. Architecture decision records, specs and written invariants keep both humans and agents on track, and we check our code against them. Your responsibilities: Turn requirements from our customer, the MLS standard and Matrix into specs and architecture decisions. Decide with your team and our partners where a change belongs: the SDK, the server, or a spec proposal. Build and run server-side MLS components in Rust, including message delivery, the Matrix integration and federation between servers. Ship your work to production yourself, including in our customer's environments. Contribute to spec proposals where they affect what we build. Improve our agent workflows and share what you learn. What you should bring: At least three years of experience with Rust in production, including async Rust (Tokio or similar). You already work with coding agents every day and have your own workflows for them. Sharp judgment in code review: you notice when generated code looks plausible but is wrong, for example a race in message ordering or an error path that silently loses state. Experience with distributed systems or network protocols: ordering, consistency, failure modes. You can read an RFC and turn it into code and tests. You enjoy writing: specs, decision records, review comments. Fluent German and English. Nice to have: MLS, MIMI, Matrix, applied cryptography, experience in regulated markets (public sector, healthcare, critical infrastructure), or rigorous testing approaches such as property-based testing. Please note: For this position, we are currently only able to consider applications from candidates based in EU/EEA. Why you should work at Famedly: Work at a fast-growing startup in an exciting phase. Since 2019 we have grown rapidly and we have big plans ahead! Famedly brought the first gematik-certified TI-Messenger to market, and with your help we're now bringing MLS-secured messaging to the public sector. Meaningful ownership. Take responsibility for software people rely on every day in critical environments. Deep technical work. Help build one of the first MLS deployments in the German public sector, on a protocol whose ecosystem is still taking shape. Small, close-knit teams. Work in a small team with short decision paths. Modern AI tooling. Use up-to-date coding agents and models without having to count tokens. Your perfect work-life balance. With remote work and flexible hours, you decide when and where you are most productive. You also have the option to work from our office in Berlin. Your choice: set up your home office or use a co-working space! Attractive conditions. A permanent contract with competitive compensation, a training budget, work equipment of your choice, and 28 vacation days per year. Flexible Benefits with Probonio. You receive a monthly wellbeing budget that you can use for vouchers from a wide range of food, mobility, retail, and lifestyle partners or for a discounted membership with Urban Sports Club. A diverse and international team. We value an open mindset and a diverse, inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome. Regular team events. Workshops, team-building activities, virtual game nights, and company events such as our Summer and Winter Summit. We are a proud equal-opportunities employer and place great value on mutual tolerance and acceptance in a diverse environment. Everyone receives the same opportunities in our application process. We look forward to hearing from you! Sounds good? What are you waiting for? Apply now! We are excited to get to know you!
